events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: Sir Michael Philip Jagger, lead singer of The Rolling Stones, was born on July 26, 1943, in Dartford, Kent.

angles.name: Rock Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Still strutting his stuff at 83! Tomorrow, we're celebrating the one and only Mick Jagger. What's your ultimate Rolling Stones anthem?

events.title: MTV launched 45 years ago
events.blurb: On August 1, 1981, MTV officially launched, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' being the very first music video ever aired.

angles.name: MTV's Impact
angles.copy: 45 years ago today, MTV burst onto our screens, forever changing the music landscape. And yes, the first video was 'Video Killed The Radio Star' – how prophetic!

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, which quickly became the fastest-selling debut album in British history.

angles.name: Britpop Classic
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and kicked off a Britpop revolution. What's your favourite track from this absolute classic?

events.title: 57 years since Woodstock
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace & Music Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people gathered for '3 Days of Peace & Music' at Woodstock. Which iconic performance from the festival still resonates with you?

events.title: 49th anniversary of Elvis Presley's death
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll,' passed away on August 16, 1977, leaving behind an unparalleled musical legacy.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Today marks 49 years since we lost the King, Elvis Presley. His music continues to influence generations. What's your all-time favourite Elvis hit?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Christine Ellen Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951, in Akron, Ohio.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and songwriting with The Pretenders have given us so many unforgettable tracks.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: William John Paul Gallagher, best known as the frontman of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972, in Manchester, England.

angles.name: Rock Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's critically acclaimed second solo album, 'Imagine,' was released in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago this week, John Lennon released the 'Imagine' album. Its timeless message of peace and unity still resonates globally.

events.title: It's James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No,' in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic theme tunes to thrilling gadgets, what's your favourite Bond film or the song that always gets you in 007 mood?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Winston Ono Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and a prolific solo artist, was born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool, England.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His incredible songwriting and enduring message of peace continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: John Marwood Cleese, the legendary English actor, comedian, and writer, was born on October 27, 1939, in Weston-super-Mare, Somerset.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is unmatched. What's your favourite Cleese moment?
